keyVerseDR: "Rejoice in the Lord always; again, I say, rejoice." (Phil 4:4)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Humor
level1.story: Humor means bringing smiles and seeing the bright side, with jokes that never hurt anyone.
level1.keyLine: I rejoice in the Lord always!
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice humor all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What made our family laugh together this week?
How can we tell if a joke is kind?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Lord, fill me with Your joy. Help me bring smiles that never hurt anyone. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Tell a kind joke at dinner
WED: Laugh at your own small mistake
THU: Find the bright side of a bad moment
FRI: Play a silly game with your family

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Humor
level2.story: Humor means enjoying laughter, bringing smiles to others, and seeing the bright side of things. Good humor is playful and kind; it never makes fun of someone or hurts their feelings. Saints like Philip Neri and Thomas More loved to laugh. Saint Paul says to rejoice in the Lord always. Joy is a sign that we trust God, even on cloudy days.
level2.keyLine: I rejoice in the Lord always!
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice humor all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What made our family laugh together this week?
How did God help us grow in humor?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Lord, fill me with Your joy. Help me bring smiles that never hurt anyone. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Cheer up someone with kind humor
TUE: Never laugh at someone, only with them
WED: Turn a grumpy moment into a smile
THU: Learn about joyful Saint Philip Neri
FRI: Plan a family game or funny-story night
